name: shadow-text
title: Shadow Text
description: A hero heading whose letters throw long, soft shadows angled by the time of day or by the pointer acting as a lamp. A subtitle and call-to-action button sit beneath.
use: A landing hero needs a large headline that reacts to the pointer without images or extra weight.
avoid: Long shadows only read on a plain contrasting surface; on busy backgrounds they dissolve into noise.
a11y: The visual letters are hidden from assistive tech with a plain copy provided; reduced motion snaps shadows instead of animating. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A large white sans-serif headline sits centred in a dark rounded panel above a muted subtitle and a small white pill button. Each letter carries a long soft black shadow stretching away, and a tiny mono line at the bottom-left records the time.
behaves: The shadows rest at an angle set from the clock and tick forward every half minute. Moving the pointer near the text turns it into a lamp, so every letter's shadow swings and stretches away from the cursor.
customise: The headline is passed as children; the element tag, clock-driven lighting, pointer takeover and shadow reach are props, while the shadow formula is fixed.
weight: light: A few dozen letter spans and a short rAF that runs only while the shadows settle.
demo: Headline 'Golden hour, every day.', a Lumen photo-time subtitle, a Get Lumen button and a 'Shadows set for' note.
polishWhy: Long shadows read cleanly and the pointer lamp feels physical; the surrounding copy is plain.
